The Ekeleshuun key is obtained after excavating the barricade and going through the most south-eastern tunnel in the tunnels at the Warforge Dig Site.
After the key is obtained, the tunnel would collapse as you escape.
The exquisite spear is a two-handed, multi-tier melee weapon obtained from the Squeal of Fortune or Vic's Store.
The forgotten painting is created by assembling five different forgotten painting pieces.
Forgotten painting pieces can be found while participating in various activities around Havenhythe.
Friend in Need was an aura available as part of the Members Loyalty Programme, which could be purchased from Xuan in Burthorpe for 3,500 Loyalty Points.
They can be unlocked by redeeming a Frosty Cerberus gloves token.
Frosty shoulder cape is a reward from Yak Track: The Winter Trials premium task 50.
Furniture plans: Armadyl altar are a rare item dropped by Kree'arra, his minions, and Armadylean followers in the God Wars Dungeon.
Ghrazi weapons is a boss trophy obtained from defeating The Ghrazi Blood Knights.

Golden Dharok's platebody.x: The Golden Dharok's platebody is armour worn in the torso slot that can be won from the Balthazar's Big Raffle from 2015 onward.

sc: The golden gnome hat 2011, along with the Golden Gnome pet, is a reward given to the winners of the Golden Gnome Awards 2011.
Since it is no longer obtainable, it is one of the rarest items in the game, having only 7 owners overall.
Despite the fact that Golden Gnome awarded in 2011 had a different look, the hat has the same design as the gnome awarded in 2013.
It is unlocked by inspecting the Gordie pet, found while training Dungeoneering.
Gordie comes from a family of hoardstalkers, but wishes to become a worldbearer itself so it can travel the world.
Grotesque (Tier 1) Legs is a legs slot cosmetic override that can be purchased for 200 credits from the Trader's Store or for 1,500 Double XP Tokens from the DXP Token Store.
It could be unlocked with 1,000 Valentine's petals.
It was re-released during the 2022 Valentine's promotion Gifts from the Heart for 1,125 Heartments, it can be obtained again in the re-run of the promotion in 2023.
Howie is pet unlocked after completing all prestiges of the tribal task list or by redeeming a tribal pet token.
The infernal urn (full) is an item made by filling an infernal urn with either impious ashes, accursed ashes, or infernal ashes.
It, along with the regular Slayer master skillcape, could be unlocked by accounts in the Fresh Start Worlds game mode that reached level 120 Slayer.

The cape can also still be unlocked by any account in the main game by consuming an Inverted Slayer master skillcape token, though the inverted cape can only be equipped if the player also has level 120 Slayer.
The Iorwerth 2h curved sword is a cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing task 27 of the Yak to the Light event.
The katagon platelegs is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Smithing skill.
A large XP lamp (Slayer) is an uncommon prize from Treasure Hunter.

Legatus Maximus Boots.x: The Legatus Maximus Boots are a feet slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by completing Children of Mah. They are part of the Legatus Maximus outfit.

Manticore Shortbow.x: Manticore Shortbow is a two-handed ranged weapon cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Manticore Ranged Weapon Pack.

sc: It is created by attaching a longbow sight to a maple longbow while having 45 Ranged.
A longbow sight can be bought from Daemonheim Rewards for 10,000 Dungeoneering tokens.
A marmaros lantern is an off-hand necromancy weapon available in Daemonheim.
It can be made using ensouled marmaros bars at level 24 Smithing.
The Mask of Reflection is a slayer mask obtainable from the Shattered Worlds Reward Shop for 3.
It can be obtained by admiring the Ornate grave in Falador Park after obtaining the master max cape and completionist cape (t) and having them in your inventory.
Unlocking the ability to obtain this cape completes the achievement with the same name.

Obsidian Kal-Xil Cape.x: The Obsidian Kal-Xil Cape is a back slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Obsidian Kal Cape Bundle.

sc: To obtain this item, players must partake in smithing a ceremonial sword after randomly being given plans when they finish smithing an item in the Artisans' Workshop.
Although only members can smith this sword and it is untradeable, the wield option and the stats are available in free-to-play.
It can be created with level 103 Fletching by stringing an unstrung primal crossbow with a crossbow string.
It is created by lighting a oil lantern (oil) and can be extinguished to return it to the unlit state.

It is made with level 26 Crafting by using an oil lamp (empty) with an iron oil lantern frame to create a oil lantern (empty), giving 50 Crafting experience, then filling the empty lantern with lamp oil (distilled from swamp tar) at the Chemist's west of Rimmington.

A soulrune robe bottom is tier 9 necromancy tank leg armour available in Daemonheim as part of the soulrune armour set.
It is made from ensouled runic cloth and ensouled thread with level 86 Crafting.
Spooky Cape is a back slot cosmetic override that can be purchased for 1,500 H'oddments from the H'oddments Store.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 45 of Count Yakula's Yak Track.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 steel bars, requiring 600 progress to complete, granting a total of 150 Smithing experience.

The third age carafe is an ancient artefact available as a drop from revenants in the Forinthry Dungeon.
